rows.en:
(Phew, studying nonstop gets old...
Maybe it's time for a change of pace...)
(Sneak, sneak...)
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; sound-effect stage direction kosokoso, kept in brackets.

rows.en: Hm? Who's that over there...?
Ranka? What are you doing?
(Flinch!!)

I knew it, it's Ranka.
What are you doing in a place like this?
Uuu...
rows.notes: x4, Ranka here; also the player in nml_itk_012 (both genders).

rows.en:
From the look of things,
are you cramming for exams?

Um~...
Things have gotten really busy lately,
so I've been neglecting my studies...

Ahaha!
The idol business sure is tough!
Geez! It's not funny~!
Ah, sorry, sorry.
So, what are you studying?
Um~, math...

Math, huh? I could help you with it,
if you want...

Huh?!
Are you sure?!

Yeah. Teaching someone else
is good study for me, too.
Then please help me!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; onegai shimasu, she asks the player.

rows.en:
So, if you do this here,
it all comes out clean, right?
rows.notes: x2, player (both genders), explaining the math problem.

rows.en:
You're right!
So if I do that, then this part goes...
Oh! I get it!!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; koko ga are de (vague 'this goes like that') rendered as her thinking aloud.

rows.en:
Alri~ght!
I'm gonna solve it!!
Yeah, yeah, that's the spirit.
You pick things up surprisingly fast, Ranka.
Huh?! That's so mean!

Ahaha.
Well, if you keep this up,
I think you'll catch up in no time.
Yeah, thanks!
rows.notes: x3, Ranka here; also the female player in nml_myk_015.

rows.en: You really saved me today!
If I can help, I'm always happy to pitch in.

Yeah, thanks!
Well, Big Bro will worry about me,
so I'd better head home!
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; oniichan = Ozma, 'Big Bro' as in ext_rnk_001.

rows.en: (Studying's more fun when you do it together.)
Ranka-chan, what are you doing?

I knew it, it's Ranka-chan.
What are you doing in a place like this?

From the look of things,
you're cramming for exams, huh?

Ufufu!
The idol business must be tough!
Sorry, sorry...
rows.notes: x2, female player here; also the male player in nml_myk_011.

rows.en: So, what were you studying?

Math, huh? I could help you with it,
if you want...
Yeah, yeah, go for it!

You pick things up surprisingly fast,
Ranka-chan.

Ahaha.
Well, if you keep this up,
you'll catch up in no time, I'm sure.
If I can help, I'm always happy to pitch in.
Okay, get home safe~
(Studying's fun with Ranka-chan around.)
(Okay, maybe I'll knock out my homework...)
rows.notes: x2, player (both genders), second visit of frd_rnk_006.

rows.en:
\p-kun!
We meet again!
Studying again?

Yeah. If I slack off on my studies,
Big Bro will get mad at me...

I know it's hard to juggle both, but
I'll help if you want me to,
so just ask me anything.
rows.notes: Male; juggling idol work and school.

rows.en:
Really?!
Then, about this part here...

Thanks for today!
You're really good at explaining stuff.
Nah, I don't think so...
Teaching other people helps me study, too.
I'll pay you back for this sometime!
I'll wait, but I won't hold my breath.
Geez~ You don't have to put it like that!
Sorry, sorry.
rows.notes: x3, male player here; also the player in nml_yui_014 (both genders).

rows.en: (Well, I'd better head home, too.)

\p-chan!
We meet again!
Are you studying all by yourself?

I know it's hard to juggle both, but
I'll help if you want me to,
so just ask me anything.
Nah, that's not true.

Teaching other people
helps you study, too, you know.
I won't hold my breath!
Ahaha, sorry, sorry.
(Guess I'll head home, too.)
